editorial.blurb: A unique Sichuan kitchen with bold, authentic flavors that impress adventurous diners—though service and wait times can test your patience.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to pre-order during peak hours; reviewers note long waits and chaotic kitchen management, but patience is rewarded with standout dishes like gong bao chicken and dan dan mian.
